changes: cencode: observed UTF-8 byte display widths, source labels, replace order, empty-label and zero-observation metadata.
crangestat: native source_stat output names and statistic labels; first/last retain missing endpoints and excludeself replaces self with ordinary missing.
cwinsor: generated missing codes, labels, storage formats, grouped default numeric type; ungrouped trim returns C quantiles for native Stata local-macro rounding before comparison.
test_changes: No tolerance reductions or skips. Added direct differential regressions for the corrected semantics.
Legacy crangestat auto-name expectations now use the native rangestat naming convention.

benchmark_winsor now uses documented replacement winsor2 instead of gstats winsor, whose trim-boundary rounding differs. Matching unexpected errors now fail; extended missing codes must agree exactly.
limitations: This verifies the scoped cases and component suites, not universal equivalence. Failures in other commands from the earlier full audit were not addressed in this batch.
